title: Medication shortage substitution decision log
summary: Documents medicine shortages safely without guessing substitutions or sharing medicines.
content: Medication shortage substitution decision log is a practical offline routine for medication continuity. List each medicine from its original label with person, remaining quantity, and prescriber if known. Mark medicines that the person was warned not to stop suddenly. Contact a pharmacist, doctor, clinic, or emergency line before changing dose or substitution. Count remaining days and warn before the last doses instead of waiting until empty. Store medicines by person and label, away from heat, moisture, children, and mixed containers.
